title: EU has no idea who will pay for €90 bn Ukraine loan – MEP
description: The EU still has no idea how the burden of the €90 bn Ukraine loan will be distributed among member states, MEP Fabio De Masi said Read Full Article at RT.com

analysis.summary: EU's statement indicates a potential shift in global economic dynamics, particularly in addressing the Ukraine debt issue. The situation highlights the need for coordinated efforts between EU members to manage the crisis effectively.
